caption: The app Home page with the label Live and the message Your loyalty program is live (Customers earn points on real orders from now on. You can pause it from the menu at the top of this page.), the checklist Finish your setup at 2 of 5 (Decide what gives points and Add a reward done; Set up tiers, Add the launcher to your shop and Build your loyalty page open), a preview of the member card, and on the right Where members see it (Customer account page On; Launcher, Points on products, Points in the cart and Loyalty page Off) and Free plan with 0 of 200 orders this month; the store name on the member card and in the bottom left corner is hidden.

The Program page with the label Live: Points on orders for All products, On the subtotal, Not on gift cards, Points arrive when the order is paid, at 5 points per $1; Ways to earn (Sign up for an account 250 points, Follow on Instagram 50, Follow on TikTok 50, Subscribe to our newsletter 100, Celebrate a birthday and Daily store visit Off); the start of Rewards; and a preview A member's page with 0 points, Choose an amount at 100 points = $1 and Free shipping at 500 points; the store name in the preview and in the bottom left corner is hidden.

The Settings Plan page with the notice Development store (Select any plan and approve Shopify's test subscription. No real charge is made on this development store.), Your plan Free with 0 of 200 orders, a switch Monthly or Yearly, 2 months free, the text 14-day free trial on every paid plan, and the plans Starter at $29 every 30 days with 500 orders a month and Essential at $129 every 30 days with 2,000 orders a month (Most shops pick this), each with Start 14-day free trial and New test subscription, no charge; the store name in the bottom left corner is hidden.

The Shopify Approve subscription screen for Loyalino: Loyalty & Rewards by Appal.io with the notice You will not be billed for this test charge., the plan Loyalino Starter (Monthly) at $29,00 USD every 30 days, an Add payment method row, a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., a subtotal of $29,00 plus any applicable taxes, a total of $29,00 due 1 Dec. and an Approve button that could be clicked; the store name in the bottom left corner is hidden.
